# GitHub repository About section

Use this when the repo sidebar shows **“No description, website, or topics provided.”**

**Author:** Nitesh Kumar Singh (nkscoder) · https://nkscoder.in

---

## Option A — One command (GitHub CLI)

```bash
brew install gh          # if needed
gh auth login            # once, as nkscoder
./scripts/update-github-about.sh
```

---

## Option B — Manual (gear icon on GitHub)

1. Open https://github.com/nkscoder/feedback  
2. Click the **gear** next to **About** (right sidebar)  
3. Paste the fields below → **Save changes**

### Description

```
Open-source Django feedback plugin by Nitesh Kumar Singh (nkscoder). Collect anonymous or authenticated user feedback with ratings, cooldown rules, and an AI analytics dashboard. Install: pip install nkscoder-django-feedback
```

### Website

```
https://pypi.org/project/nkscoder-django-feedback/
```

## What appears in About after saving

| Field | Value |
|-------|--------|
| Description | Short pitch + install command |
| Website | PyPI project page (clickable link) |
| Topics | Searchable tags for GitHub & Google |
| License | MIT (from LICENSE file — already detected) |
| Readme | Linked automatically |
